sentence_stem: The government's decision to reduce funding
full_sentence: The government's decision to reduce funding has caused concern among teachers.

options.why_wrong: The subject 'decision' is singular, so the verb must be 'has', not 'have'.
An infinitive cannot serve as the main verb of the sentence after this subject noun phrase.
The -ing form cannot act as the main verb here without an auxiliary, so the sentence stays incomplete.

grammar_focus: Subject-verb agreement after a nominalized subject
explanation: In academic style, the noun 'decision' carries the whole action of the clause, so the main verb must be a singular present perfect that agrees with it. Learners often choose the plural verb form because they look at the nouns that follow instead of the head noun.
